metadata.question: Was the NVDI lower in northern Kenya than in southern Kenya during May-June 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is asking to compare NDVI values between northern Kenya and southern Kenya during May-June 2019. 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS NDVI data (MOD13Q1.006) which provides 16-day NDVI composites - Time period: May 1 - June 30, 2019 - Two regions: northern Kenya and southern Kenya - Need to define polygons for both regions 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS NDVI already has quality control, but we should use the "DetailedQA" band to mask poor quality pixels - MODIS DetailedQA bits: bits 0-1 (VI quality), bits 2-5 (VI usefulness) 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NDVI for northern Kenya region - Calculate mean NDVI for southern Kenya region - Compare the two values - Check for valid data in both regions - If northern NDVI < southern NDVI → A: Yes - Else → B: No I need to define reasonable polygons for northern and southern Kenya. Kenya spans roughly from 5°N to 5°S latitude and 34°E to 42°E longitude. I'll split it roughly at the equator. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define regions - northern and southern Kenya const northernKenya = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[34, 5], [42, 5], [42, 0], [34, 0], [34, 5]] ]); const southernKenya = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[34, 0], [42, 0], [42, -5], [34, -5], [34, 0]] ]); // Time period: May-June 2019 const startDate = '2019-05-01'; const endDate = '2019-06-30'; // Load MODIS NDVI data const modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(northernKenya.union(southernKenya)); // Check if collection is empty const colSize = modisCol.size().getInfo(); if (colSize === 0) { console.log(`MODIS Images: ${colSize}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // Create a composite for the period and apply quality mask const composite = modisCol.median(); // Extract NDVI band and scale (scale factor: 0.0001) const ndvi = composite.select('NDVI').multiply(0.0001); // Apply quality mask using DetailedQA band const qualityMask = composite.select('DetailedQA').bitwiseAnd(0b111111).eq(0); const maskedNdvi = ndvi.updateMask(qualityMask); // Calculate mean NDVI for both regions const northStats = maskedNdvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: northernKenya, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const southStats = maskedNdvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: southernKenya, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const northData = northStats.getInfo(); const southData = southStats.getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels if (northData.NDVI_count === 0 || southData.NDVI_count === 0) { console.log(`North pixels: ${northData.NDVI_count}, South pixels: ${southData.NDVI_count}`); console.log("C2"); return; } const northNdvi = northData.NDVI_mean; const southNdvi = southData.NDVI_mean; // Validate results if (northNdvi === null || southNdvi === null || isNaN(northNdvi) || isNaN(southNdvi) || northNdvi < -1 || northNdvi > 1 || southNdvi < -1 || southNdvi > 1) { console.log(`Invalid NDVI values - North: ${northNdvi}, South: ${southNdvi}`); console.log("C3"); return; } // Print stats and determine answer console.log(`North Kenya NDVI: ${northNdvi.toFixed(3)} (pixels: ${northData.NDVI_count})`); console.log(`South Kenya NDVI: ${southNdvi.toFixed(3)} (pixels: ${southData.NDVI_count})`); console.log(`Images in period: ${colSize}`); if (northNdvi < southNdvi) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
